acceptanceCriteria: An edited or new unanchored citation row in a legacy-list document fails line-citations-check with a repin hint.
Untouched legacy rows keep passing; the legacy unpinned count cannot grow.
A regression test covers the stale-but-nonblank-line case.
body: From V1-1943 / PR #1207: docs/specs/js-live-test-provider-v0.md is on script/line-citation-legacy-documents.txt, where content anchors are optional, so a stale playwright.go:91 passed because the line was non-blank. Six rows in one table drifted up to 23 lines unnoticed. Expected: drift detected. Options: require @hash anchors on newly added or edited citation rows in legacy documents, and/or lower the legacy unpinned ceiling over time.
title: line-citations-check: unanchored citations in legacy-list specs drift silently (one table drifted up to 23 lines)
